goal: Compute budget-vs-actual variance and percent variance for a small portfolio of departments read from an in-repo CSV extract, so that a portfolio-level percentage is trustworthy and not just a per-department convenience number.

acceptance.statement: The portfolio percent variance is recomputed from summed budget and actual figures, not averaged from per-department percentages.
A department with a missing (blank) budget is never silently folded into totals as a zero budget.
